snippet.title: ANIMO Stars Arena - Official Trailer - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
The latest trailer for ANIMO Stars Arena, which showcases the playable characters and gameplay modes of this upcoming animal based mech battler. The game blends adorable animal pilots with powerful mech juggernauts, in epic battles with evolving battlescapes that will keep you constantly tinkering with your loadouts and fully customized war machines! It comes to PC in spring of 2026 - try the demo on Steam and Wishlist now. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #Animostarsarena
